answer: Continuous attention escrow keeps each identity in a live session through unpredictable probe windows; one probe may ask whether a basalt texture changed. A missed window resets the clock and forfeits prior attention credit, even if the next probe shows a sparrow. Each identity consumes separate operator minutes per interval, and the attacker pays that labor plus reset penalties for every clone. A pearl image can serve as another probe token, but it does not shorten the required live minutes.
